name: Fun City Foods, Inc.
old_description: Back by popular demand, we’ve decided to rush our player's choice card cookies back into production. Within each bag is a whole deck of... cookies. Delicious, sweet, shortbread cookies. Available only at Fun City, we’re proud to get these back in.
about:
Fun City Foods, Inc. operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, at 3555 West Reno Avenue. The company's founding year is not publicly stated. Lon Ross serves as president and is the only leadership figure identified in the source material; ownership structure (family, veteran, woman-owned, etc.) is not disclosed.

The firm functions as a master food‑service distributor for major brands including Mars, Hershey and Nestlé, and supplements that line with equipment sales and service. It also markets an exclusive private‑label item, Player's Choice Card Cookies — a shortbread cookie packaged as a full deck of cards — which it describes as being rushed back into production by popular demand. No facility square footage, headcount or annual volume figures are provided.

Customers span the food‑service spectrum, from large accounts carrying national confectionery lines to smaller operators seeking popcorn, candy, snacks and beverages. The company emphasizes "nationwide supply, local availability" and states it serves "big or small" clients alike. Concrete brand examples are the three named suppliers: Mars, Hershey and Nestlé.

The company's stated differentiator is a service philosophy summed up by President Lon Ross: "Our business model is built on the fact that we never say no." This commitment to flexibility is presented as the core reason the business exists and the basis for its customer relationships.
